_note: The commander's tutorial. Steps run in order on sol 1. 'until' = what the player must do to move on (or 'next': true for a Next button). 'skipIf' = skip the step if already true. 'target' = CSS selector to spotlight (null = the map). Portraits: an emoji placeholder for now; replace with an image path like 'assets/commander-happy.png' when the art is ready.

steps.text: Welcome to Mars! I'm Commander Nova. Our crew of 4 just landed, and keeping them alive is your job. I'll show you the basics.
These are our supplies. Keep an eye on 'sols left'. A sol is one day on Mars, about 40 minutes longer than a day on Earth.
Mission control sends one task every sol. Finish it for a reward. Today's job: we need air!
Tap Build to see what we can construct.
Pick the Oxygen Plant. It turns carbon dioxide from the Martian air into oxygen we can breathe.
Now tap a spot on the map near the habitat. Green means it fits, red means it doesn't.
Uh oh, the Oxygen Plant uses a lot of power and our Power number is negative. Build Solar Arrays until it's positive.
Building costs metal. See the 🔩 rocks? Those are iron meteorites. Tap one to send our rover to collect it. Each trip uses some battery power.
We're ready. Press Start sol and time starts running.
While the sol runs, rovers drive and supplies change. When you've done what you need, press End sol to skip to the end of the day.
Every sol ends with a report: what went up, what went down, and how your task went. That's the basics. I'll be on the radio if anything happens. Good luck!

decision.text: A Mars event! Every choice has a cost, so think about what our base can handle. The 'This really happened' box is a true story from a real space mission.

ended.text: Every mission teaches something, even a failed one. Read why it ended, then try again with a new plan.
